newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Building collapse kills two in Vietnam soccer game.
newsitem.headline: Building collapse kills two in Vietnam soccer game.

text.p: Two teenagers died on Sunday and 15 others were injured when a building overlooking a stadium collapsed during a soccer match in northern Vietnam.

Hospital officials in Vinh City, some 300 km (200 miles) south of Hanoi, said on Monday the victims had been standing on the roof of the building where they had been watching a match between provincial teams from over the stadium wall.
One person died immediately, the other died in hospital. The official said the building had collapsed under the weight of spectators.
